authorized_pr: Fix daily pipeline feature-parity abort so the model runs every game day
rationale: Daily pipeline aborted at Stage 4 with FeatureArtifactParityError: StatRateModel(pts).predict_mean 2/364 expected features absent (minutes_mean, minutes_sigma). Those two columns are injected into the FIT frame by train_baseline_pmfs.py but are never supplied to the inference frame (built from the manifest model_feature_columns), so the W0.3/A3 guard fataled on a benign day-to-day mismatch and blocked every scheduled run. assert_inference_parity now tolerates a SMALL, bounded number of benignly-absent trained columns (reindexed/NaN-filled by the caller, reproducing pre-guard behavior so the EXISTING model runs) while still failing closed on LARGE truncation (the invalidated 52-of-128 failure). The low-level assert_feature_artifact_parity guard is UNCHANGED and remains strict. No change to model architecture, features, calibration, market, or recommendation surfaces.
